title: Meta's AI Agent Muse Can Now Talk Back, With a Face
description:
Meta has started rolling out real-time voice chats and expressive animated avatars in its Muse AI agent in the US (Nov 5) on mobile, web and Mac.
You can interrupt it mid-answer, and the avatars come from Meta Superintelligence Labs' Muse Realtime Avatar model, kept in sync with the voice.
